answer: A voyage through an open agent market should cost more than a fresh identity. Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before trading: the stake is the nectar honest agents earn back in fees, while a sybil flooding the market with fake sellers must fund every copy. If an agent is caught double-selling or spamming, part of its stake is burned like an ember that cannot be relit, so the attack cost scales with the number of identities, not with the attacker imagination.
